items.summary: Force HTTPS for all app pages by implementing a client-side redirect whenever the app is loaded over `http:` (including deep links), preserving the full path, query string, and hash during the redirect.

Add standard security headers for the frontend asset canister by updating `frontend/public/.ic-assets.json5` to include common hardening headers (at minimum: `Strict-Transport-Security`, `X-Content-Type-Options`, `Referrer-Policy`, `Permissions-Policy`, and a restrictive `Content-Security-Policy`) for `index.html` and other served assets where appropriate.

Ensure basic rate limiting is applied to all state-changing backend entrypoints (forms/APIs) by auditing `backend/main.mo` and adding `checkRateLimit(...)` enforcement anywhere it is missing for `shared` update methods that mutate state or perform privileged actions.

Validate and sanitize all user-controlled inputs on both frontend and backend: trim strings, enforce maximum lengths, enforce allowed character sets where sensible, and validate structured fields (DOB format, ZIP, state/state_name, gender, height, id/order IDs) before storing or using them.

Add CSRF protection for state-changing operations by introducing a CSRF token flow: provide a backend method to mint/return a token scoped to the caller and require that token to be supplied and validated for mutating backend calls initiated from the UI.

Create custom, friendly error pages: a Not Found (404) page for unknown routes and a generic Error (500) page for unexpected route/app errors, using TanStack Router’s not-found and error handling so users see helpful guidance and a way back to the home/dashboard.
